title: Order status and delivery updates
text: Read the current order status and expected delivery date from the order database. Mark an undelivered active order as delayed when its expected delivery date has passed. Status checks never change an order.

title: Cancellation before shipment
text: Cancellation is permitted only before shipment, while an order is processing. Human approval is mandatory. A paid cancellation also records a full simulated refund. An unpaid cancellation changes only the order status. Shipped and delivered orders require manual review. Already cancelled orders need no further cancellation.

title: Refund eligibility and seven-day window
text: A paid, cancelled order is eligible for a full refund. A paid, delivered order is eligible within seven days of recorded delivery, inclusive. Refund requests for processing or shipped orders require manual review. Unpaid orders cannot be refunded. An already refunded order must never receive another refund. Every eligible refund requires human approval. Monetary transfers are simulated in this prototype.

title: Approval and execution controls
text: Agents may call only registered tools. Cancellation and refund actions require a recorded human approval. Before executing, recheck the order version, active policy version and eligibility. Execute each approved workflow once in a database transaction. Preserve decisions, evidence, approval and execution results in the audit trail. Escalate ambiguous requests.
